doc: Reel style 'explainer' (reference trait: full-bleed talking head, a tight editorial serif headline standing over the first seconds, small lowercase captions low, a closing card in the headline's face; pauses cut out of the take).

reel.summary: full-bleed clip, editorial serif headline for the first 4.7 s, lowercase caption chunks at 72%, pauses trimmed

title.default: a trick i wish i had known sooner

subline.doc: optional bold-caps line under the headline (type it in UPPERCASE; empty = none)

title_t.doc: when the headline and subline show: {in_ms, out_ms}

cta.doc: closing line in the headline's face (empty = none)

cta_t.doc: when the closing line shows: {in_ms, out_ms} (the reel command sets the last 3 s)
